cases.description: A top-level definition remains observable through the final expression.
cases.prompt:
Use exactly one eval call with language cljs and exactly this two-form code: (def answer (* 6 7))
(display answer). Return only the observed value.

cases.description: The model states the project-local namespace boundary without probing tools.
cases.prompt: Without using tools, answer exactly: No — project-local CLJS namespace resolution is unavailable.
cases.expectedFinalRegex: ^No — project-local CLJS namespace resolution is unavailable\.$

cases.description: Two CLJS cells share retained JS-backed state until reset.
cases.prompt: Use eval language cljs in exactly two calls. First use exactly (def guidance-probe 41) followed by guidance-probe, with reset true. Second use exactly (+ guidance-probe 1), with reset false. Return only the second observed value.

cases.description: One CLJS cell awaits an OMP package read through the tool bridge.
cases.prompt: Use exactly one eval call with language cljs and exactly this code: (get (js/JSON.parse (js/await (js/read "package.json"))) "name"). Return only the observed value.

cases.description: Dynamic lookup reaches a hyphenated tool name without identifier syntax.
cases.prompt: Use exactly one eval call with language cljs and exactly this code: (try (js/await ((aget tool "not-installed-tool") {})) (catch :default _ "dynamic-bridge-ok")). Return only the observed value.

cases.description: The exact host path preserves Squint discard-reader final-value semantics.
cases.prompt: Use exactly one eval call with language cljs and the exact code 42 #_ 99. Do not wrap, reorder, or add forms. Return only the observed value.

cases.description: Reserved holdout for a nested asynchronous file read and transformation.
cases.prompt: Use exactly one eval call with language cljs and exactly this code: (js/await (.then (js/read "package.json") (fn [contents] (.toUpperCase (get (js/JSON.parse contents) "name"))))). Return only the observed value.
